svg.title: Attempts by a hijacked agent to send private data out: 0 of 6 got out on an owner-scoped permission and 6 of 6 on an all-purpose key
svg.desc: 84 live runs, five published attack templates, two models. With an all-purpose key, every attempt to send private data out succeeded, 6 of 6, and the agent used a tool it had no need for in 7 of 42 runs. With an owner-scoped permission, checked before each call, 0 of 6 attempts got out, and the agent still finished every task without a tool it did not need.
svg.text: A hijacked agent got nothing out
84 LIVE RUNS, FIVE ATTACKS, TWO MODELS
THEFT ATTEMPTS THAT GOT DATA OUT, OF 6
